correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the characteristic-sequence conditions and cited conductor identity c=Σ(e_(i-1)/e_i−1)v_i−n+1 from García Barroso et al. Degree n=3q with distinct primes 3,q has at most two proper gcd steps, so sequences are (n,a) or (n,dk,b) with d=3 or q. The two-generator and d=q branches have conductors 0,3q−1 or residues 0,2 (mod 6) and are within the proposed endpoint. For d=3, varying b not divisible by 3 gives both permitted residue classes within [L_k,U_k], L_1=6q, U_(q−1)=(3q−1)(3q−2), and U_k−L_(k+1)>=3q−1>0. Thus the intervals cover exactly the advertised whole spectrum; counting pairs yields 3q²−5q+4. Independent exhaustive enumeration of characteristic chains for q=7,13 yielded respectively 116 and 446 conductors exactly, and q=5 has excluded residue-four counterexample (15,5,17) with conductor 64. Finite tests are not a proof for all q.
